'''R-A7''' was an [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] that accompanied [[MR-T3/Legends|MR-T3]], an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic military base|military base]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], when [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escaped]] from the base, after being suspected with murdering [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]]. As Tano was running away from the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]], she quickly jumped over MR-T3, causing the droid to spin around.
